queries_run: Deckers Brands wholesale customer credit downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2026（截至2026-03-31）無單一客戶占淨銷售10%以上；但有一家客戶占應收帳款淨額18.5%（前一年13.6%），該應收通常無擔保，帶來收款風險。
findings.excerpt: However, no single customer accounted for 10.0% or more of our total net sales during fiscal year 2026. The failure to increase sales to these customers could negatively affect our growth prospects, and any reduction or loss of their business could materially and adversely affect our net sales and results of operations, particularly if we are unable to offset such declines through our DTC channel. As of March 31, 2026, one customer represents 18.5% of trade accounts receivable, net, which is generally unsecured and exposes us to collection risk that could affect our results of operations and liquidity.

findings.claim: 財報附註：2024–2026三個會計年度均無單一客戶占淨銷售10%以上；單一客戶應收占比由13.6%升至18.5%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 財報附註
findings.excerpt: Customer Concentration. For the years ended March 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, no single global customer comprised 10.0% or more of the Company’s total net sales. As of March 31, 2026, the Company has one customer that represents 18.5% of trade accounts receivable, net, compared to one customer that represents 13.6% of trade accounts receivable, net, as of March 31, 2025.

note: 搜尋未找到批發客戶信用降評或破產的來源。
